This is done in a way similar to the famous "Lights Out" game. You move your cursor with the joystick and press "Fire" to invert all the squares in a 2x2 section that your cursor is touching. There are 16 initial setups in total to solve

417943.overview: Move your needle ship around the fixed screen, bubbles will be floating up from the bottom of the screen. You must use your close range needler to pop the bubbles before they reach the top of the screen. Touching the bubbles will sap your energy.

417944.overview: A stay on the road style game created by Majorsky78 and released to PD in 2008 in the 20 Zeilen BASIC Compo.

418003.overview: A 2D role playing game. Black Knight takes place in 1980, when an evil sorcerer appeared in the Dunkan's kingdom, settled the abandoned castle and began to rob the local inhabitants. Kidnapping a daughter of the king named Reja forced him to hire a black knight, whose task is to defeat Mephistopheles and rebound from his hands the successor of the throne. As a knight the player must go through the castle, defeat numerous enemies and avoid magical traps. Reaching the next levels requires finding a key that will open the closed bars. Numerous magical items scattered around the castle can be as helpful as a faithful knight's companion - a sword.

418028.overview: A single player game created by Caveman/PSW for the Minigame Competition 2006 - 1K Category.

418029.overview: A puzzle type game from Charles Grey and published in GO64! 2006/03-05, it was a 596k byte to begin with, then some improvements were made. Was part of the Treasure Max release 2.

418034.overview: Charles Grey (Iceout) has a new game for the Commodore C64. The game is very small, it is only 256 Bytes. That is only 1 block to disk. In the game you have to top them up with the bottom. You can adjust the patterns using the joystick (left / right) or the reverse pattern (up / down). If the two patterns are correct you can add them together with the fire button.

418035.overview:
The eighth game in the series by Andreas Kwias aka Holy Moses, the action puzzle was created in 2023. Subtitled Scarab School Trip. Another version of Boulder Dash Junior created by the Raiders of the Lost Empire group.  Holy Moses from Raiders of the Lost Empire is practically responsible for the entire project.  The music composer is Ghormak, and the author of Loader is Krill from the Plush group. 

 I'm warning you!  The game is programmed to troll or annoy the player.   If you don't have nerves of steel, don't play this part.  I'm afraid of the next installments of the series.

418044.overview: A single player shoot'em up from Richard Bayliss in 2006. Difficulty: not a SEUCK game! This one was made for the Commodore 64 Crap Game Compo 2006 (C64CGC) held in June of that year.

418046.overview: A single person shooter by Christian Kleinhuis and released for Minigame Competition 2006 - 1K Category / 1K Minigame Wettbewerb 2006 and also in GO64! 2006/03-05.

418105.overview: Bloop! is a simple collect em up for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Brandon Williamson and released by PhoenixWare on the Cassette 50 Plus cassette. The game itself was not part of the competition, but was added to the cassette as a bonus game.

418126.overview: Blox Trot is a 2 player only puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Arthur Moore and published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1994/01.

418135.overview:
Blow It is a 1-2 player clone of Bomberman for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Gerrit Knoef and published in Input 64 1986/12. The game also includes speech. Blow it: training game for under cover agents. This game was written by the Dutch author Gerrit Knoef, so this time the texts within the program are, contrary to our usual habit, in English. You can play alone or in pairs, with two players you can choose whether you want to play consecutively or simultaneously. To play simultaneously, select the COOPERATE YES option. The aim of the game is to get as many points as possible, you get them in different ways. Repelled monsters score 100 or 150 points, depending on their type.
 
Monsters want to get you. Try to escape them and find the hidden treasures. But be careful, it's all too easy to blow yourself up with non-suicidal intent. An uncovered and collected treasure is worth 500 points. If you complete a level within the time limit, you get additional bonus points. In order to find the treasure or to make your way, you have to blast through the cracks in the masonry. You place the bombs required for this by pressing the action button on the joystick or press the corresponding button. After a moment the bomb will explode, so get to safety and keep your distance! You can also use this method to fend off attacking monsters. When the time is up or you have caught all the monsters, you go to the next level. Some levels get tricky: in the Auto-Bomb level you lose the bombs by yourself. And then there's the level where a prankster turns off the light and you have to find your way in the dark. But players with strong nerves will also be able to do this.

418704.overview:
Basketball Sam & Ed (one title) is a 1-2 player competitive loose interpretation of a basketball game, in which both players play as basketballs with arms and legs. The goal is to jump and make it into the baskets. The game was developed by Rhett Anderson & David Hensley Jr. and published as a type-in game in the following:

-   COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1987/07 (Issue #49)
-   COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1988 Special Issue/ a.k.a. "Basket Balls"

There is no assigned basket, you can score in either 1 of the 3 that are on the screen.

419227.overview:
Despite its name, Bug Splat is not an action based game, rather it's a dice based gambling/board game in which you have to build a bug by rolling the dice. The game was coded entirely in BASIC and developed by Cout Games. It was released into the public domain on October 1, 2017.


The game is actually an unofficial conversion of an old VIC-20 type-in game from 1982.

419243.overview:
Blackbeard the Pirate (also known as The Adventures of Blackbeard) is a text adventure with selectable answers for the C64.

In this swashbuckling adventure, you play the infamous Blackbeard on a search for treasure.

The game was developed by Phil Wulf and published by Compu-Story in 1985.

419249.overview:
Bully is a 2 player only vs 2 on 2 ice hockey game for the C64. It was developed by Thorsten Feiweier and published in the following:

-   64'er 1988/09
-   64'er Sonderheft 37
-   64'er Sonderheft 53

419334.overview: Bunny Chase is a maze collect em up for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Jay Taplin and published in ReRun 1992/03-04.

419794.overview:
Backfire is a public domain game for the Commodore 64. It is heavily influenced by Andrew Braybook's classic, Uridium.

Backfire also included Rob Hubbard's music from Delta (added without permission). 

The game was developed by Jonas Hedlstroem and released into the public domain in 1991.

421117.overview:
No way! Yes way. This, my friends, is the conversion of the legendary Bill & Ted Game Boy™ game by LJN/Beam Software to the Commodore 64.

I used to have this cartdrige in the 90's with my Game Boy and really enjoyed the fast pace and simple but addictive game mechanics. Also the music is great. And you can play as Keanu Reeves - what could be more awesome. So I remade the game from scratch for the C64. SID music was done by Nordischsound. Enjoy! It's free!

421652.overview:
A Week That Changed the World is the second game in Series 2 of the Baker Street Kids franchise, with stories written by father/son duo V. Gilbert Beers and Ronald Beers. It consists of 14 Bible stories, starting with Jesus' triumphant entry into Jerusalem, going through Holy Week to the Passion of the Lord, and ending with the death of Judas Iscariot.

After selecting one of fourteen stories, you are given a choice of one of three difficulty levels: Tough, Very Tough, or Super Tough. For each story selection, you get to read the story (some of them riddled with typos and some inaccuracies in Bible translation), and then answer several questions about it, consisting of choosing one of three options. Frequently the questions will be true or false questions, but because there are three options, one option will be "who knows?", "doesn't say", "maybe", "don't know", etc. -- which is guaranteed to be wrong. Once you get at least most of the answers right, you are treated to a little light animation.

421822.overview:
Black on Black: The Card Game is a game developed by Logiker and released into the public domain on April 15, 2023.

In this game, you simply have to count the cards on each stack. First cards appear, then cards get moved. That's it!

Eeach round, more cards are added and more moves are done.

You have to guess all four cards right in order to advance to another round, otherwise it's game over.

424173.overview:
It's a hyper-casual game for the old C64 computer written in assembly code.
the game was as an entry to the RESET64 4Kb Craptastic Compo 2022.

Okay, so is it a racing game?

Ha! Nope. It's much simpler than that.
The aim of the game is to drive as long as you can, trying to avoid running out of fuel and avoiding hazards.
Controls are simple. Just press FIRE on joystick in Port 2 to change the direction the car rotates/drives. This is how you navigate around the screen to try to collect gas cannisters to replenish your fuel.

Bonus points are awarded every time you collect a gas cannister.

You can speed up and slow down the car by pushing UP or DOWN on the joystick.

Why would we wanna do that, Roysterini?

Well, I'm glad you asked.
Speeding up might make things trickier, but it also will increase your score pickup multiplier. You can have a max of THREE times multiplier for your gas cannister collection score. However, if you wuss out and go too slow, your multiplier will drop to 0.5.

That's it. Just try to beat your best scores. Anything over 800 is VERY respectable.

Download and play in you fave C64 Emulator or load on hardware if you have the facility to do so.

Game was designed primarily for PAL C64, but it should run okay on NTSC. It might sound a bit odd on NTSC, but the game will play the same.

424212.overview:
Finally a great conversion for our beloved C64! Developed especially for and released during the Mamemeister Charity Stream on 5th November 2023. Assemble all the burgers on the screen to complete each level. Tread on the burger ingredients to send them falling down to the level below. If an ingredient hits another it will knock that down too. Drop burger ingredients onto enemies to kill them. Lure enemies onto ingredients and they will fall with them, earning big bonuses. Falling ingredients with enemies on will fall further and create big chain reactions. Hit fire to throw pepper at enemies and stun them temporarily. Collect bonus ice cream, coffee and fries to earn bonuses and an extra pepper. Extra life awarded for every 20,000 point.

For the time being, all proceeds for this game go to the following charities (both based in Scotland):

Spark
HSTAR

424215.overview: Boulder Dash levels created by youngsters FOR youngsters. All levels verified playable and geared for beginner play. A Happy Halloween gift to all of you, but especially to the young and the young at heart.

424235.overview: Babylon was a preview platform game for one created by Kopido Games aka the "Paralax [Preview]" in 1996.

425174.overview:
Follow the adventures of Briley, a modern day girl lost in a strange new world...

Take control of Briley as she continues to explore her new life, aided by Smokey, her grumpy talking cat - and best friend. 

Features:

    Japanese-inspired RPG, with full-screen scrolling.
    Hours and hours of gameplay (19+ with normal play).
    Story-driven, following the plot of Briley Witch novels 5 & 6.
    Turn based combat, also with cats!
    Gather ingredients to make powerful potions.
    Lots of characters to talk to.
    Supports 2-button C64GS or compatible joysticks.
    Can be played entirely with a one-button joystick.
    Save/load to either cartridge or disk.
    Includes a full A5 manual (full colour or printer friendly).
    PAL and NTSC compatible.
    TheC64 Mini & Maxi compatible.

425242.overview: An Arcade Collect'em up, created by Matthias Hillebrand and published in both 64'er 1991/07 and later in Commodore Scene #22.

425258.overview: A snake game created by István "Steveboy" Maros in BASIC and released on August 7, 2023.

425261.overview: Keep the squares from going out of bounds. Use Up\Down on your joystick to steer the blue square, left and right to guide the red square. How long can you keep it up? Merge both squares for a bonus. It does faster the longer you can keep it up! Game ends if either square goes past limit.

425412.overview: A Conan the Barbarian inspired vertically scrolling co-op shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Peta Software using Chris Yates' SEUCK game creation system. It was released in 1993.

425418.overview:
A 4K game made by Bartosz Zolynski  of Commocore for the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition (5th place).  It's a 4-kilobyte version of a shoot-n-collect pseudo 3d game for Commodore 64 which uses only PETSCII graphics (built-in characters). Buckle up, beat the beasts, and... bring back my bones!

In this swift shoot-n-collect pseudo 3D game, you are to bring together the scattered bones of your crazy uncle. He may have left you a hefty sum... but you won't know it until you talk to his ghost, stuck in between worlds.

So venture into the dark forest to gather all his bones. Watch out though - it's no mushroom picking.

His earthly remains are closely guarded by some seriously scary soul-devouring beasts. Once you've got them all, cook up some fresh broth - and hear back from your uncle!

Bones, beasts, and broth - what a craptastic story!

425419.overview: The sequel to the original Boxnightmare (from the 2021 Cassette 50 Plus C64 Game Jam), features more box merging action, plus new graphics and bonus modes. It is a one player game created by Iceout Games and released as PD in 2023.

425425.overview:
Binal Wordz follows the originals rules of Wordz, only that you now have to guess two secret 5-letter words instead just one. 

To begin, type a 5-letter word (or if you wish to cheat any random 5 letters) and then press Enter/Return.  If you make a mistake, you can press backspace before you submit your guess.

After each attempt , the colour of the letter for each word will change in one of three ways:- 

    Green - right letter, right position 
    Yellow - right letter, different position 
    Gray - letter not in that  word.


If after seven attempts, you have not guessed both secret words, they will be revealed to you.

425442.overview:
The objective of the game is to take the honeycombs and advance as far as possible. But not everything is as easy as it seems! the worker bees will defend their honey and their queen. As you progress through the levels, more angry bees will appear! And to complicate things even more, a porcupine appears from time to time. If any touch you, you will lose 1 energy point.

Released as part of the 2022 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition.

425632.overview: Bullshit is a Minesweeper clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Space Moguls and released as part of PhoenixWare's Cassette 50 Charity Competition in 2020.

425667.overview:
You have just woken up to find out your floppy disk is full of viruses! Unfortunately, it contains the only copy source code of the game you have been working on in the past months...
Recover the source code before the disk is damaged beyond repair! Luckily, you have an excellent antivirus program, Binary Battle, at your disposal. Use it to destroy all the viruses before it is too late.

443999.overview: BattlePong (also called Battlepong and Battle Pong) for the Commodore 64 is a 2 player only Pong variant played on a grid. It was developed by Vulcan Logic and released into the public domain in 2022.

446610.overview: Blind is a game made by Pinhead Games for the Commodore 64. It was made using Garry Kitchen's Gamemaker. The year of release is currently unknown.

446688.overview: Bre4Kout is a simple game written in BASIC V2.0 for the Commodore 64 inspired by Breakout and Arkanoid

447001.overview:
C64 conversion of a 1988 Spectrum adventure game that was included in Load'n'Run #45.

The C64 conversion was done by Carmine Migliaccio.

447904.overview: Are you ready for the truth? You wake up in a damp and cold cell. Your head hurts like it has been smashed with something and you feel very dizzy. You can’t remember who you are and why you are locked in. You need to find a way out of this place and find out who you are.

448476.overview: Avoid the falling blocks and collect the *S* for extra Shield. Things go faster as the game goes on. How long can you last?

448767.overview: 20 new caves to puzzle out and 4 intermissions from the German creator Ustar23 (aka UnlimitedStar23), released in 2010 using the CLCK CrayZ Light Tools V3.0 engine. This game is intended to be of a very high difficulty. It includes exploding bombs and movable boxes, plus a nasty surprise.

448861.overview: A Boulder Dash game created by Hungarian Zoltán Scserbin.

449394.overview: A Boulder Dash game created by Hungarian Zoltán Scserbin.

449669.overview:
Bug is a BASIC game., originally published as a type-in program in the 1978 book "BASIC Computer Games - Microcomputer Edition".  The object is to finish your drawing of a bug before the computer finishes. You and the computer roll a die alternately with each number standing for a part of the bug. 

You must add the parts in the right order; in other words, you cannot have a neck until you have a body, you cannot have a head until you have a neck, and so on.  After each new part has been added, you have the option of seeing pictures of the two bugs as ASCII art.

449743.overview: A Boulder Dash game created by Hungarian Zoltán Scserbin. The third in a series of 3 games. 20 new caves of fun with 4 expert levels to master.

451304.overview:
Balrog's Day Out is the fourth in a series of humorous text adventures featuring the balrog and his troublesome digestive tract.

The first episode in the story saw Balrog happily evacuating his bowels when someone locked him in the outside toilet.

The theme continues through to this game which sees Balrog venture out to a theme park with his family. The general whirling, spinning, chuck-you-about nature of the rides has a predictable effect on Balrog's innards and the object of the game is to get him across the park to the safety of a lavatory, with a coin to operate the door and paper for ..... .

451441.overview: The Bard's Tale: Tales of the Unknown has been released as a CRT download suitable for installing on an Easyflash cartridge for the Commodore 64. This classic tile-based RPG is regarded as one of the founding fathers of the genre, and is still extremely playable. Even more so, now, as this Atlantis release has fixed the cumbersome multi-load format of the original cassette and disk versions. As well as adding new features such as extensive documentation including a handy map of "Skara Brae" (the main town where you start), German and English localization, a new main menu with quick access to the Party creator, training modes and the game's first sound track which you can hear while reading the docs and a special surprise hidden away!

451445.overview: What will, unfortunately, be the last installment...or issue perhaps .. of the Balrog on the Bog series. So, while John may have left us to go find his next great adventure, his work from this adventure lives on in countless ways. That's not bad going for a Balrog from Rochdale.

451478.overview:
Balrog stood halfway down the garden path, in one hand he held a small black box and in the other a crumpled sheet of paper. The pale sunlight glinted off his shiny boots and there was a touch of frost in the air, Balrog sensed the approach of Winter.

Overhead a flock of black birds whirled in flight, constantly casting glances in the direction of the roof. What will you do?

452147.overview:
Black Hole is an unofficial clone/port of the 1986 Atari 2600 game "Solaris" for the Commodore 64.

The game was developed by Peter Otto and released by Blueguard in 2024.

452309.overview:
Guide the little bat up the caves, facing enemies of all kinds. Try to complete all levels in the shortest time possible.

To maneuver the bat, you will have to use only the fire button, which will allow it to fly. Every time you touch a wall, it will change the direction of flight.

This game participates in the Reset Craptastic 2024 4K game composition.

The game runs on the c64 real machine or any c64 emulator.

452315.overview:
A jump and run platform game. Control a bacillus to hunt for food.  Created by Thorsten Jordan aka thojor79. 

    2-way side scrolling game (smooth 50 fps)
    parallax scrolling
    animated background and level data
    animated characters
    bonus collecting
    score accounting
    intro
    main screen
    3 levels in 3 worlds
    special tiles that vaporize
    special boni like invulnerability and 1-up
    dying animation
    enemies leaving screen stay alive and can return
    cheat in main menu to select level
    two different actor behaviours
    traps
    high scores loaded from and saved to disk
    Outtro

452640.overview:
This game is a remake of Mr. Speed's Black Ninja, A 1989 game originally written for the Commodore Plus/4 in German. A very simplistic, linear adventure that can also be called a guessing game, with only two actions available at each scene.

The story itself is a violence filled journey, definitely not for kids. I'm a bit fascinated by it, as it's a video game equivalent of gory doodles schoolkids draw in their exercise books during the more boring classes.

Now you can enjoy the inside of Mr. Speed's mind (as it was in 1989) with the relative comfort of having joystick controls, and an English version aside the German one. Have fun! :)

453438.overview: This is the work-in-progress Commodore 64 version of the popular indie game, Balatro. While it’s not a full port, the core gameplay and mechanics remain the same.

453471.overview: Pixilated scenes of explicit violence and gore included. Grab all the skulls you can, drop crosses on the heads of the ghouls and make your way to the tomb that calls to you. If you are wise you can also brick your foes up, The Cask of Amontillado style.

453673.overview: Besieged is a 1994 board/strategy game for 1 player. It was developed by Mike Marino and Paul Fackler and published in Loadstar #124.

453804.overview:
Battle for Cronos is a turn based wargame for up to four players. 

To be successful on the battlefield, you must effectively combine different unit types, take the terrain into account, and plan your supplies strategically.

454540.overview:
Brain Bricks is a puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Daimansion (Graphics), Georg Rottensteiner (code), and Christian Gleinser (sfx/music)

The game was released for free into the public domain in Digital Talk #109 (24.12.2020)

The game is playable in both English and German.

455523.overview:
Baker's Dozen is a patience or card solitaire using a single pack of fifty-two playing cards. The game is so called because of the 13 columns in the game, the number in a baker's dozen.

This 1998 implantation of the game to the C64 was developed by Maurice Jones and published in Loadstar #172.

455644.overview: Basic Slot Machine is a simple simulation game of a classic slot machine written in Basic V2.0 (with a very small assembly routine for some animations) for the glorious Commodore 64.

455698.overview:
Barrier System is a unique twist on the classic Breakout/Arkanoid formula. Instead of clearing all bricks, your goal is to break through the barrier at the top of the screen by removing at least one brick from the top row. This strategic shift adds a new layer of depth, requiring precision rather than total destruction.

Unlike traditional paddle mechanics, the bat in Barrier System is fully maneuverable both horizontally and vertically, giving players more control over their shots and positioning. However, an added challenge comes in the form of roaming enemies, such as UFOs, which move across the screen. Colliding with these hazards costs the player a life, adding an element of danger beyond just keeping the ball in play.

With its innovative mechanics and arcade-style gameplay, Barrier System offers a fresh challenge for fans of brick-breaking games.

455700.overview:
Barriere is a 1-player Breakout clone for the Commodore 64.

The game was developed by Michael Ruedig and published in Compute mit 1984/39 (19.09.1984)

455871.overview: The aim of the game is to exit from a maze, choosing the right door and avoiding the monster that chase you. You have a limited time to choose, and to explore the various doors. It is a self-competiting game, and it is designed for one player.

456443.overview: Ballon Hunter is is a run and gun style shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Puppa Productions using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit and released into the public domain in 1990.

456456.overview:
SEUCK Compo Entry # 3

Bang City, one of the most dangerous places nobody would dare to walk or even ride a bike through. What was originally a friendly place, with communities has been transformed into a murderous street filled with criminal gangs. Unfortunately, since the criminal gangs took over the city. The civilians are trapped inside their own homes living in fear. The local mayor has had enough and has called in someone to clear the crime ridden streets, unfortunately, that is you.

PLAYING THE GAME

Your mission is to go through five different levels and fight against the criminal gang members. They are armed with guns and explosives. You are only armed with a rifle. You can only shoot upwards or diagonally upwards. The enemies, however can fire in all directions.

Watch out for the enemy bullets and also the enemy vehicles - although it is possible to blow the vehicles up. There are five stages to battle your way through. If you reach the last stage, there is a chance you will encounter the ring leader and his armed henchmen. Defeat them all to clear the streets for good.

456500.overview: A 1-2 player seuck game developed by Richard Bayliss.

456504.overview: Little puzzle game for MS-DOS based IBM PCs and compatibles, and Commodore 64.

456636.overview: A 1-5 player dice game published in the book "The Big Fat Book of Commodore 64 Games" in 1984.

456640.overview: A miscellaneous arcade style maze game developed by Bill Root and published in COMPUTE! 1984/07 (Issue #50)

456643.overview: Blueberries is a single player run and gun shooter developed by Alf Yngve using the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit, and released in 1992.

456794.overview: Beastoids is a 1-4 player pinball game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Charles M. Duncan and released as part of PCS Club Disk #21 in 1991.

456961.overview:
Bob's Bakery is a public domain single-screen platformer with some resemblance to BurgerTime.

The developer is unknown, but the game itself was released in Stonysoft #0398.

457108.overview:
Barney: The Cowfish is a side scrolling game for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Shaun Pearson (with music by Richard Bayliss) using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit.

Unlike the vast majority of games made with the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit, Barney: The Cowfish is a side scrolling collect 'em up/avoid the enemies type of game.

You also only have ONE LIFE in this game.

It was released as part of the 2010 Sideways SEUCK Competition.

Collect the pearls, but avoid hitting enemies or surfaces on the bottom of the ocean.

457281.overview:
Blue Ribbon Game Pak was an Australian exclusive compilation pack for the C64, and published by ECP in 1986.

It includes 5 games originally published by Epyx in North America

The games include:

-  Championship Wrestling
-  Summer Games II
-  Super Cycle
-  Winter Games
-  World Games.

457363.overview:
2025 SEUCK Compo Entry #11

In the laboratory of the eccentric scientist, Doctor Krantz, bizarre and mysterious creatures are collected and stored in jars, ready to be studied in his experiments. Hi obsession? Observing how these strange beings interact with one another and analysing their behaviour.

PLAYING THE GAME:

In this game, you'll take control of two of these experiments:

Player 1 - Thumby - Small but mighty! Thumby's secret weapon is the ability to suddenly grow in size and power, crushing obstacles with unexpected force.
Player 2 - Wormy - Slippery and clever. Wormy can stretch into a spiralling coil, wrapping around enemies and twisting through tight spaces with ease.

Moving from jar to jar, you'll explore the intricate mazes spread throughout the lab, but beware! These paths change constantly, making every challenge unpredictable and full of dangers.

You'll encounter other creatures roaming the corridors and face countless perils.

457768.overview:
Block is a 2 player only TRON Light Cycles variant for the Commodore 64.

It was developed and released by PDK in 1984.

457965.overview: Battlot is yet another one of the many cross-platform games developed by Japanese coder Inufuto. This one is a maze shooter, and was released in 2021.

459096.overview:
Blockwords is a 1998 crossword puzzle variant for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Robert Markland.

It was originally released in Loadstar #167, and later released again  in Loadstar #238.

459097.overview: The Brass Ring is a 1999 solitaire card game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Maurice Jones and published in Loadstar #181.

459271.overview:
Bombardment is a 2 player only vs duel shooter for the Commodore 64.

The two players start out with 5 lives. The winner is the first player to take all the other player's lives. If two players shoot at the same time, the bullets ricochet off each other.

The game was developed by Forrest Bentley and published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1989/01 (Issue #67).

459682.overview:
Brubaker is an icon-driven adventure. An aged former CIA agent, you found your own agency and accept a simple mission to transport a barrel of plutonium to another location. As you fly over the Bermuda Triangle, your plane is shot and you are stranded in a strange world.

The game has a score and several, partially unforeseeable, unwinnable and deadly situations. Like the previous Byteriders adventures, the writing is humorous, although this time more cynical than absurd. It was published in German language only, but has been unofficially translated into English.

Released in Golden Disk 64 1992/03

459736.overview:
Bristol is a computerized version of the popular solitaire card game of the same name. Developed by Maurice Jones, it was published in Issue #180 of Loadstar Disk Magazine in 1999.

Bristol is a patience game played with a standard 52-card deck. It resembles the fan-type game La Belle Lucie and features a unique mechanic where cards can be built regardless of suit, both on the foundations and the tableau. This game is known for being one of the easiest to win and was invented by Morehead & Mott-Smith around 1950.

**Rules:**

Eight piles (or fans) of three cards each are dealt onto the tableau. If any king is not at the bottom of its pile, it is moved underneath. Then, three additional cards are placed under these piles, forming the bases for the three reserve piles.

Whenever an ace becomes available, it starts a foundation that can be built up to a king, regardless of suit. The same applies to the other three aces.

The top card of each tableau pile and the top card of each reserve pile can be played on the foundations or the tableau. Like the foundations, tableau piles are built down, regardless of suit. Only one card can be moved at a time, and when a pile becomes empty, it is never refilled.

Cards from the stock are dealt to the reserve three at a time, one for each pile. Consequently, gaps in the reserve are filled during the deal; therefore, when a reserve pile becomes empty, it is not filled until the next batch of three cards is dealt.

The game is won when all cards are placed in the foundations. Given that all building is done without regard to suit, the chances of achieving this are quite high.

460133.overview: Someone jacked all the beer from Devlab/TSA HQ — now the next Chill & Grill party is in danger!  No way Don Zabelinho lets that slide – he's track the thief through the forest!

460439.overview: The rules of the game are very simple. You need to collect coloured objects in the right order to get more time to complete the next level. The task is made more difficult by the effect of inertia and the drifting of objects across the board.

460862.overview:
This is a traditional game with a difference. You play it against the computer. The computer knows the rules of the game, but it does not know how to win. At first it makes its moves entirely at random, so you stand a good chance of winning. But, after you have played against it several times, it makes good moves more often and bad moves less often. It learns from its mistakes and takes note of its successes. You may then find it much more difficult to beat it.
This simple game is a fascinating one in its own right. Played against a computer which is capable of learning to improve its play is a somewhat unusual experience. 

Published in the book "The Commodore 64 Games Book - 21 Sensational Games".

461054.overview: Defend the planet from alien attack.

461058.overview: Buggy is a commercially released 1-2 player cooperative shooter for the Commodore 64, made using Chris Yates' SEUCK engine. It was developed and released by Outlaw-Emix Sodtware in 1991.

461251.overview: Bhangman64 is a computer version of the popular game Hangman. It was originally programmed by Alberto Sgaggero on the Commodore VIC-20

462092.overview: Battle for Frost is a turn based wargame for up to four players. To be successful on the battlefield, you must effectively combine different unit types, take the terrain into account and plan your supplies strategically.

462192.overview: Bubble Bobble C64 Remastered is a fan-made radical enhancement—with all-new graphics—of the Commodore 64 version of Taito's Bubble Bobble, originally developed by Software Creations and published by Firebird in 1987.

462671.overview:
A single-player vertically scrolling shooter made with SEUCK, and developed and published by Commodore Spain, and was released as part of the 2017 Spanish SEUCK Compo.

The game creates a pseudo 3D effect by adding line drawn "buildings/walls" on the sides of the screen.

463565.overview: A single-player vertically scrolling shoot 'em up developed by Andrea Germi using the Shoot 'Em Up Constructiion Kit and released into the public domain in 2022.

463572.overview: Bubble War is a 1-2 player co-operative shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Roberto Comuniello and released into the public domain in 1991.

463584.overview:
Big Road Challenge 3 is a one-player-only "racing" style SEUCK game for the C64. It was developed by Roberto Ricioppo of TND and released in 2015.

Cruise along the road, and shoot the villain drivers during your journey. Both yourself and villains are armed with guns. So you had better watch out. Good luck driver. It is the BIG ROAD CHALLENGE 3!

464511.overview: Trapped in a single-screen haze of a seedy pub on your Commodore 64, where every decision blurs reality and madness. Interact with three unpredictable regulars through drinks, chats, insults, and risky searches—while keeping your "level" balanced to dodge alcohol poisoning.

464853.overview:
SEUCK Compo 2025 - Part 2 - Entry #10 - Bubble Duck by TND Games

You are Bubble Duck, a cute yellow duck who likes to sail across the sea. His life was great, he had the freedom to explore the world. Bubble Duck was sailing across the sea inside his boat the SS.Quack. Unfortunately he felt a sudden bump on the boat - unaware that underneath it was a grumpy fat shark. It kept attacking the bottom of the boat and the boat unfortunately sank to the very bottom of the sea into the abyss. It was lucky that Bubble Duck got inside his magic bubble and survived his terrifying ordeal.

Now he needs to search for a new transport to get him back to the surface again so that he can go home back to his beloved family. The good news is that there is a Submarine available, but the downside is that Bubble Duck must take a long and dangerous journey across the deep depths inside the abyss.

Playing the game

This is a game for 1 player only.

Your task is to guide Bubble Duck through each of the four levels in search for a submarine. During your journey, you will encounter various sea creatures and plants. They may look cute, but they are deadly. Be warned.

Luckily the enemies can be shot using your magic bubbles. If you shoot an enemy enough times, you will score points. Avoid contact with the enemies and their magic bullets. Also watch outfor the deadly background.

At the end of each level you encounter a big fat grumpy shark. If you give it 15 hits, it will be defeated and you can then move onto the next level.

There are objects which you can pick up for bonus points. These objects are labelled with the letter "B" on them. There are also bombs, which when they are touched, they will destroy all enemies and collectibles on screen. Note that if you trigger a bomb, you will not score extra points, just what is scored on detonating the bomb.Remember to also rescue stranded ducks.Collecting those objects can push you forwards towards earning an extra life.

You will start the game with a limited shield, which will not last long. It will be given to you everytime you start a new game or after you lose a life. You will have 7 lives to start with and extra lives are awarded everytime the 10,000 points are scored.

Can Bubble Duck reach the Submarine or will the poor duck fade into the abyss forever?.

464876.overview: Play Birdle pretty much like how you play Wordle, but you are not limited to only typing valid words. You can type in any old crap. This is a C64 and I ain't even gonna try to make it have a full comprehensive list of valid 5 letter words. I'm not a mad man.

465499.overview: Cut the dwarves' beards - but they grow fast!

465723.overview: Battle in the Woods (also known as Battle on the Woods) is a single-player only vertically scroling shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Giuseppe Vollaro (Pinov Vox) with music by Richard Bayliss and released by TND in 2018. It was released as part of of thr 2018 SEUCK Competition.

466571.overview: To win, drink all beer and avoid being killed. Move the guy over to the shed on the right end of the screen and he will drink as much as he can.

466737.overview:
Baby Pacs is a single-player public domain Pac-Man clone/variant for the Commodore 64.

The game was developed and released by Paul Bahlawan in 1983.

467190.overview: For the first time in 39 years, Bubble Bobble on Commodore 64 receives a true spiritual sequel.

467790.overview:
In this game, you put tetris like pieces that can't rotate on a playboard : there are two different colors and you can only put a piece on it's opposite color. When you drop a piece on the board, you get a new one of the other color and you earn one point. Game stops when you can't put anymore piece on the board, so there is a minimum of strategy to be used.

Best way to control the game is using the keyboard :

-    Cursor keys to move the active piece
-    Enter to drop the piece on the board
-    Z to cycle between the pieces (or 1-4 to select a piece)
-    R to restart game
-    H for help
-    C for credits
-    M to change game mode : Normal / Extended

468571.overview:
Bricks ‘N Balls is a Breakout/Arkanoid clone, which was initially only released tto ZZap! 64's patron rembers, but has since been uploaded by the developers on itch.io and on the csdb.

It can be controlled via a joystick, paddle, or 1351 mouse.

469448.overview: Black Warrior is a 1-player SEUCK game developed by Gaetano Chiummo and published in 1991 by Sea Software.

470447.overview:
Bitcoin Miner is a simple "mining" game for the C64.

It was developed by Roman Werner and released as part of the 2018 BASIC 10Liner contest.

470670.overview: Bubble Buddies is a reimagination of Bubble Bobble, arguably the best c64 game ever. With 100 brand new levels designed for maximum happiness, Bubble Buddies emphasizes unique level design with a wider range of gameplay and a slightly easier playthrough with a smooth difficulty curve.

471167.overview: These two lie for a living: the moment they open their mouths, a lie comes out. Your mission? Catch them in the act as fast as you can!

471867.overview:
This is a merge between Block'n'Bubble and Brektwon. That means it's an action and logical puzzle game.

After the bold wizard had recovered the treasures from the vaults of the Seraphim and settled himself comfortably into his stylish, newly purchased, fantastic, magnificent, and enchanting castle, he soon grew bored. All the coins had been counted, all the diamonds polished, all the golden goblets, necklaces, and rings buffed to a brilliant shine. But what now?

Then he remembered his cousin, who more than 30 years earlier had tried to steal the treasures from an evil wizard named Brektwon and had failed miserably, as he had apparently not been quite the great wizard he believed himself to be. So then: surely there were still a few coins and pretty necklaces to be fetched as decoration for his dining hall…

Over the past decades, Brektwon had spread across an island and built numerous castles and catacombs in which he had left behind his little henchmen, all meant to drive away greedy visitors. He had transformed the glittering treasures into magical spheres, which were no less valuable than gold coins. He himself, however, had died and transformed his spirit in his private hall into a malevolent guardian that must be defeated if one wishes to claim a large slice of the treasure pie.

472266.overview: A procedurally generated roguelike for the Commodore 64, inspired by classic 80s dungeon crawlers.

472482.overview: This is a classic hot air balloon game

474008.overview: BREAKOUT challenges you to master one of the most addictive formulas in video game history. Take control of the paddle, keep the ball in play, and carve your way through 30 levels featuring unique patterns and increasingly durable walls.

474152.overview:
You are the well known archeologist Fumbling Fred, renowned for his successful rebuilding of ancient ruins from more than sketchy details while pocketing some undisclosed amounts of gold. Thus well endowed with academic laurels and the necessary funding, you take on the quest to rebuild sixteen ancient altars that have been broken thousands of years ago.

All archaeologists start with a basic pickaxe and acquire additional tools buying from a shop in between excavation campaigns.  You collect gold and altar pieces.  Once you buy the ancient papyri showing the layout of the altar to rebuild, you can try to piece the collected fragments back together to advance to the next.

The game is designed to work best with mouse and keyboard control, but can also be played with joystick alone or joystick and keyboard.

474236.overview: Berzerk is a pioneering first-person maze shooter where the player navigates a labyrinth, shooting enemies and collecting items. It is historically significant for being one of the first games to feature a 'kill screen' and for its unique perspective for the era.

474237.overview: Big Bird's Fun House is an educational adventure game for the Commodore 64 based on the popular Sesame Street character. Players explore various rooms in Big Bird's house, completing interactive puzzles and activities designed to teach children basic skills.

477374.overview: Puzzle-Bobble on the C64: fire coloured bubbles into the raft overhead, match three to pop, and cut the supports so whole clumps rain down. Every 8 shots the ceiling pushes down a row — clear the raft before it reaches the rail.

478032.overview: Train the barbarian's beheading move on a corpse that is thrown in by magic.

478245.overview: A single-screen arena brawler for the Commodore 64. You are one barbarian in a walled pit, and the pit keeps filling up. Cut your way through twenty waves and the horde is broken. Fall, and it tells you exactly how far you got.

478531.overview: Following the 1st part your goal now is to escape from the black tower.To get out you need to collect the six magic items and find the exit. All fights are running automatically and will increase experiences and gold.

479006.overview: Collect the eggs, the higher bird wins the clash. Watch out for the molten lava and being grabbed into it (level 4). This is based on a Joust-premised game that transitioned into this.

479839.overview:
Nobody agrees where the rafts come from. They arrive on the ceiling overnight, packed tight and coloured.
An original bubble shooter for the Commodore 64, written in 6502 assembly.
Leave a raft alone and it grows downward until it reaches the rail — and then the room is no longer a room.

480235.overview:
Deep beneath the earth lies a sprawling dungeon filled with monsters, traps, treasure, and ancient magic.
Your quest is to descend through 18 dangerous levels, find the legendary Magic Medallion, and make your way to the ladder to escape the Black Cave alive.
Black Cave is an action dungeon crawler created for the Commodore 64. It draws inspiration from classic games such as Gateway to Apshai, traditional Dungeons & Dragons adventures, and my earlier Windows game, Cave of Darkness.

480277.overview: A breakout game made by Zarko Zivanov & Alias Medron with music by Peter Siekmann. The game was released in Zzap!64 Micro Action #30. The game was based on  preview that came out a year earlier by the same developers at the Commodore Retro eXpo 2025 (CRX 2025).

480363.overview: Help the Barbarian king escape from the attacking snake men.

480456.overview: A Boulderdash game made with the BDCS by Daniel Tavernier (Boulderdan) and music by Jeffrey Schneider. It appeared on the Tiger-Crew-Disk #020 (11/1995).

480457.overview: A rerelease of the BMX Simulator Trilogy of games in a single, fast loading package for the C64. Includes BMX Simulator, BMX Simulator II and Pro BMX Simulator. Supports up to 4 players using 4 Player Adaptor and MultiJoy8. Fixes scoring for players on the endless time trainer and updated graphics.

480502.overview: A Boulderdash game made with the BDCS by Daniel Tavernier (Boulderdan) and music by Jeffrey Schneider. This is the final game in this series of two.

480731.overview: A dinosaur runs through an endless desert, and the cacti give it no rest — insidious, one after another, without pause.

480933.overview: Guide Baby on his adventures through mushroom manor. Your goal is to find the car, fill it up with fuel, and burn rubber out of here. But, in this house, nothing is ever straightforward. There are puzzles to solve and enemies to face, in the form of moths, dogs and endangered condors. On top of all that, you're going to need some cash for your new life so see if you can collect all 30 coins too.

480956.overview: The gameplay in Binky: Frozen in Time is refreshingly simple: walk across every freezable platform in the level to activate the exit portal, then dash through it before time runs out.

480994.overview: You and the Dealer share one shotgun. Before every load you are told how many shells are live and how many are blanks, but not the order they go in. On your turn you shoot the Dealer, or you shoot yourself and bet on a blank. Your life is a row of charges on the machine next to you, and when they run out, the game is over.

481234.overview: Bombolo, nicknamed "Venticello," is a small-time con-artist who often pretended to be a doctor along with his accomplice Lory, who played the nurse. After being in prison several times, caught by Inspector Nico Girardi, Bombolo decides to side with the law and teams up with the inspector to take down the biggest criminal gang in Rome. The Boss's identity is unknown, but Nico suspects that the mysterious criminal might be someone he knew in the past.  Bombolo and Lory try to infiltrate the criminals and uncover the mystery, but as soon as they step into the Parco della Caffarella, they are immediately spotted and attacked by the henchmen, disguised as ordinary joggers. Our two hapless heroes have no choice but to fight back, using farts and syringes. Will they manage to survive and solve the mystery?

481837.overview: The sequel to BUBBLEPOP: THE SEA — an original bubble shooter for the Commodore 64, written in 6502 assembly. You stand at the deck gun and fire, taking it apart one colour at a time. Twenty sectors. Twenty clusters. Clear the hull and bring us home.

481947.overview: Prepare yourself for a mind-bending adventure into the endless corridors of the unknown! The walls are yellow, the lights are buzzing, and something is lurking just around the next corner…

481957.overview: A highly original game for the Commodore 64. Grab the ring from the carousel.

481983.overview: Birth of the Phoenix is a classic Apple II text adventure that has finally found its way to the Commodore 64. But this isn't just another retro computer port. For me, it's the conclusion of a journey that began more than four decades ago, in an elementary school library.

482030.overview:
Daffy Duck, Sylvester, Wile E. Coyote and Yosemite Sam have captured Honey Bunny and hidden
her deep inside the Crazy Castle. Collect the carrots, outsmart the rascals and find your way
through 60 tricky stages

482106.overview: BRICK GAME 64 recreates the pocket brick-game consoles that every kid had in the 90s: a big LCD with chunky square blocks, a little dancing mascot, beeps from a piezo speaker, and "9999 games in 1" written on the box. This time it runs on a real C64 (or any C64 emulator) and is written 100% in 6502 assembler.

482198.overview:
25 levels. 3 soldiers (limit).
Run through a jungle.. (Its supposed to be a jungle lol). Destroy enemy huts and soldiers. You can pick up grenades and rockets.

482199.overview:
Black border. Black background. Black walls. And you are black too.

The only things you can see are what a guard's lamp falls on, and the darkness that hides the room from you also hides you from them. Every room of Grey Holt castle holds one treasure, glinting purple in the dark. Take it, find the door, walk out.

Play it alone: one thief, fifteen rooms, a par time for each and a rank after every room. Or bring a friend: two thieves, one joystick each, one castle full of lamps.

482272.overview:
In a desolate mountain valley in the east of France lies an abandoned castle: Chateau Roko.

The place is shunned by local villagers. It is rumored that in the castle lives a Basilisk - the mythical beast whose gaze can kill.

It is also said that the basilisk guards a vast treasure. Do you dare enter Chateau Roko, to search for the ultimate prize, and risk horrible death?

The choice is yours...

482279.overview: Every building in town is about to open, and every owner has the same plan: cut the ribbon, let the crowd in, and hope nobody finds the live wires, the hungry guard ferret and the "NOT A COMPACTOR" room before the insurance runs out. Thanos's job is to find every trap first. Since nothing can kill him, the quickest way to make a trap safe is to walk up to it and set it off. Then he signs the room off and moves on, while the crowd outside gets more impatient by the second.

482537.overview: Brainframe is a simple text-only-based Mastermind clone/variant for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Norm Vogel and published in Ahoy! 1985/07 (Issue #19).

482557.overview: An Ultima-style adventure for the Commodore 64

482561.overview: Your task is to pick up all of the stars as assigned by the counter at the top of the game screen. You must be quick because the clock will be counting down. Beware! The big bouncing ball from outer space is out there to get you!

482567.overview: THE BIRDS AND THE BEES brings the much-loved 1983 ZX Spectrum classic to the Commodore 64 in a colourful, expanded remake.

482607.overview: The third BUBBLE POP, after The Sea and In Space — an original bubble shooter for the Commodore 64

482609.overview:
Every dawn the wardens of the old tower ring it, and whatever walks the night creeps back under the ground. King Mordran fears his grave more than the dark. He has made a bargain with what sleeps beneath the moor — and he has called up a champion from the dead. You.

A Prequel To Brightmoor

482812.overview: Inspired by the classic arcade game Clowns, with original music and levels.

482824.overview: Maine, autumn 1984. On a stormy night, an accident on the highway sends you down forgotten back roads. Your car ends up in a ditch at the edge of a forest. At the end of the track stands Blackwood Manor, abandoned since that night in December 1897 when everyone who lived there died.

482834.overview: A brand-new beat-'em-up for the Commodore 64, built for real hardware. Released on cartridge, disk and tape, just like it's 1987.

482880.overview: Banana Guy sails up the river with his little boat: he loads bananas at the wooden wharves along the banks and brings them to the market at the end of the river before time runs out. On the way, smugglers try to ram him, and he fights back by throwing bunches of bananas at them!

482884.overview: DX is the bigger edition: twenty rooms, then a second night through all twenty again, and your best times saved to the disk. Alone or with a friend.

482911.overview: take a lungful of air, dive for pearls and get back to your boat before the air runs out.

482955.overview:
This is a conversion of Batman, Ocean’s 1986 ZX Spectrum isometric adventure by Jon Ritman and Bernie Drummond, which never had an official C64 version.

Game description:

Robin was repairing the Batmobile when he was kidnapped. Before Batman can contemplate rescuing him, he must reassemble the car from its seven parts. These are all over the Batcave, in this isometric arcade adventure taking in over 150 screens.

Initially Batman lacks his super powers, which must be collected. The Batbag allows you to pick up and drop objects, Jet Batboots allow you to jump, the Thruster allows Road-Runnering (movement while you fall), and the Low Gravity Batbelt keeps you in the air for longer.

Short-term bonuses of invincibility, extra energy, an extra life and an enhanced jump can be collected, but there is also one which neutralises all power-ups. You have eight lives, but each cluster of Batstones acts as a restart point - when it is game over you can return to that spot, with lives and equipment as they were.
